roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator and Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator and Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD. In this vital dual role, you will be instrumental in fostering a culture of continuous learning and ensuring the highest standards of infection prevention and control. You will play a key part in educating our staff and safeguarding the health of our residents.

This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate, providing an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on both staff competency and patient safety. If you are a passionate RN with expertise in staff development and infection control, we encourage you to apply and contribute to a supportive and professional healthcare environment.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development and/or infection control within a healthcare setting
Knowledge of state and federal regulations related to infection prevention and staff education
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, based on experience.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This critical role offers a competitive hourly rate and the flexibility of PRN scheduling, allowing you to make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being.

This is an excellent opportunity for an SLP looking to contribute their expertise in a supportive environment. A generous $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus is available for qualified candidates.
requirements: Current state licensure as a Speech-Language Pathologist in Florida
Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP) from ASHA
Experience in a rehabilitation or skilled nursing facility setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $38.00 - $49.00, with a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus available.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Special Education Teacher for a contract position in Crewe, VA. This role offers a competitive starting rate of $50+ per hour and an initial contract running for 43 weeks, beginning August 10, 2026. Join a supportive educational environment focused on providing exceptional learning experiences for students with diverse needs.

In this vital role, you will be responsible for providing direct instruction to students with disabilities, developing and implementing Individualized Education Programs (IEPs), and monitoring student progress. You will collaborate closely with general education teachers, parents, and other professionals to ensure comprehensive support and tailored educational plans. This is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on students' lives within a dynamic school setting.
requirements: Valid Virginia teaching license with an endorsement in Special Education
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Special Education or a related field
Experience working with students with diverse learning needs
Knowledge of special education laws and regulations (IDEA)
salaryOrBonusInfo: Starting at $50 per hour, with compensation based on experience and qualifications.
